        LOCATE AFTER [[254480451320573660]]#[[6503884114]]
        INSERT {
            ~&254480451320573660&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: zoteroBridgeSettingsPage
                Item {
                    id: bridgeSettings
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    property var settings: ({})
                    property var tags: []
                    property var events: []
                    property string status: "Loading bridge settings…"
                    property string queueTag: ""
                    property string syncedTag: ""
                    property string openTagPicker: ""
                    property string tagFilter: "All"
                    property bool tagsVisible: false
                    property var collections: []
                    property string collectionFilter: "All"
                    property bool collectionsVisible: false
                    property string pendingKind: ""
                    property string commandError: ""
                    property bool busy: false

                    function filteredTags() {
                        var query = openTagPicker === "queue" ? queueInput.text : syncedInput.text;
                        query = query.toLowerCase();
                        return tags.filter(function(tag) {
                            return query.length === 0 || tag.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) !== -1;
                        });
                    }

                    function visibleTags() {
                        if (tagFilter === "All") return tags;
                        if (tagFilter === "#") return tags.filter(function(tag) {
                            return tag.length > 0 && !(/[A-Za-z]/.test(tag.charAt(0)));
                        });
                        return tags.filter(function(tag) {
                            return tag.length > 0 && tag.charAt(0).toUpperCase() === tagFilter;
                        });
                    }

                    // Flattens `collections` into display order: each child
                    // directly follows its parent, carrying a depth for
                    // indentation and a "Parent / Child" path. Held as a
                    // binding so it is recomputed only when `collections`
                    // changes rather than on every filter-button tap.
                    property var collectionTree: {
                        var byParent = ({});
                        var known = ({});
                        var i;
                        for (i = 0; i < collections.length; i++) known[collections[i].key] = true;
                        for (i = 0; i < collections.length; i++) {
                            var c = collections[i];
                            // A parent outside this library would otherwise
                            // strand its children and hide them entirely.
                            var p = (c.parent && known[c.parent]) ? c.parent : "";
                            if (!byParent[p]) byParent[p] = [];
                            byParent[p].push(c);
                        }
                        var byName = function(a, b) {
                            var an = (a.name || "").toLowerCase(), bn = (b.name || "").toLowerCase();
                            return an < bn ? -1 : (an > bn ? 1 : 0);
                        };
                        for (var k in byParent) byParent[k].sort(byName);
                        var out = [];
                        var seen = ({});
                        var walk = function(parentKey, depth, prefix) {
                            var children = byParent[parentKey] || [];
                            for (var n = 0; n < children.length; n++) {
                                var child = children[n];
                                // Defensive: a cycle in cached data would
                                // otherwise recurse until the UI hangs.
                                if (seen[child.key]) continue;
                                seen[child.key] = true;
                                var childPath = prefix.length > 0 ?
                                                (prefix + " / " + child.name) : child.name;
                                out.push({key: child.key, name: child.name, path: childPath,
                                          depth: depth, flat: false});
                                walk(child.key, depth + 1, childPath);
                            }
                        };
                        walk("", 0, "");
                        return out;
                    }

                    function visibleCollections() {
                        var rows = collectionTree;
                        if (collectionFilter === "All") return rows;
                        // Filtering flattens the hierarchy and buckets by the
                        // collection's own name, so "N" finds "Notebooks"
                        // wherever it sits; the path keeps duplicates apart.
                        var out = [];
                        for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
                            var nm = (rows[i].name || "");
                            if (nm.length === 0) continue;
                            var isLetter = /[A-Za-z]/.test(nm.charAt(0));
                            var bucket = isLetter ? nm.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : "#";
                            if (bucket === collectionFilter)
                                out.push({key: rows[i].key, name: rows[i].name,
                                          path: rows[i].path, depth: 0, flat: true});
                        }
                        out.sort(function(a, b) {
                            var an = a.name.toLowerCase(), bn = b.name.toLowerCase();
                            return an < bn ? -1 : (an > bn ? 1 : 0);
                        });
                        return out;
                    }

                    function dismissKeyboard() {
                        urlInput.focus = false;
                        usernameInput.focus = false;
                        passwordInput.focus = false;
                        folderInput.focus = false;
                        listPageLimitInput.focus = false;
                        queueInput.focus = false;
                        syncedInput.focus = false;
                        reverseFolderInput.focus = false;
                        openTagPicker = "";
                        Qt.inputMethod.hide();
                    }

                    AsyncCommandExecutor {
                        id: settingsCommand
                        command: "sh"
                        property string output: ""
                        property string errorOutput: ""
                        onStdOutAvailable: function(chunk) { output += chunk; }
                        onStdErrAvailable: function(chunk) { errorOutput += chunk; }
                        onRunningChanged: {
                            if (!running && bridgeSettings.busy) {
                                bridgeSettings.finishCommand();
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    function run(arguments) {
                        if (busy) return;
                        busy = true;
                        // Both "tags" and "collections" reply with a bare JSON
                        // array, so remember which one was asked for rather
                        // than guessing from the payload shape (an empty
                        // collection list is indistinguishable otherwise).
                        pendingKind = arguments.length > 0 ? arguments[0] : "";
                        settingsCommand.output = "";
                        settingsCommand.errorOutput = "";
                        settingsCommand.arguments = [
                            "/home/root/xovi-zotero-bridge/scripts/zotbridge-run.sh"
                        ].concat(arguments);
                        if (!settingsCommand.startCommand(30000)) {
                            busy = false;
                            status = "Could not start bridge command";
                        }
                    }

                    function finishCommand() {
                        busy = false;
                        var result;
                        try { result = JSON.parse(settingsCommand.output); }
                        catch (error) {
                            status = settingsCommand.exitCode !== 0 ?
                                "Bridge command failed (exit " + settingsCommand.exitCode +
                                ", " + settingsCommand.output.length + " response bytes)" :
                                "Bridge returned an invalid response (" +
                                settingsCommand.output.length + " response bytes)";
                            return;
                        }
                        if (Array.isArray(result)) {
                            if (pendingKind === "collections") {
                                collections = result;
                                status = "Loaded " + result.length + " collections";
                            } else {
                                tags = result;
                                status = "Loaded " + result.length + " tags";
                            }
                            return;
                        }
                        if (settingsCommand.exitCode !== 0 || result.ok !== true) {
                            status = "Bridge error: " + (result.error ||
                                "command exited " + settingsCommand.exitCode);
                            return;
                        }
                        if (result.metadata) {
                            status = result.metadata === "accessible" && result.webdav === "accessible" ?
                                "Zotero API and WebDAV are reachable" : "Connection test incomplete";
                        } else if (result.webdav && typeof result.webdav === "object") {
                            settings = result;
                            urlInput.text = result.webdav.url || "";
                            usernameInput.text = result.webdav.username || "";
                            passwordInput.text = "";
                            folderInput.text = result.default_target_folder || "";
                            reverseFolderInput.text = result.reverse_sync_folder || "Zotero/Read";
                            queueTag = result.sync_queue_tag || "";
                            syncedTag = result.sync_synced_tag || "";
                            listPageLimitInput.text = String(result.list_page_limit || 8);
                            passwordHint.text = result.webdav.password_set ?
                                "Password stored; leave blank to keep it" : "No password stored";
                            status = result.applied ? "Settings saved" : "Settings loaded";
                            if (!result.applied) run(["tags", "--json"]);
                        } else if (result.entries) {
                            events = result.entries.slice().reverse();
                            status = "Loaded " + result.entries.length + " log events";
                        } else if (result.cleared !== undefined) {
                            events = [];
                            status = "Cleared " + result.cleared + " log events";
                        } else {
                            status = "Bridge returned an unsupported response";
                        }
                    }

                    function saveSettings() {
                        var parsedLimit = parseInt(listPageLimitInput.text, 10);
                        if (isNaN(parsedLimit)) parsedLimit = 8;
                        parsedLimit = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, parsedLimit));
                        var draft = {
                            version: 1,
                            webdav_url: urlInput.text,
                            webdav_username: usernameInput.text,
                            default_target_folder: folderInput.text,
                            reverse_sync_folder: reverseFolderInput.text,
                            sync_queue_tag: queueTag,
                            sync_synced_tag: syncedTag,
                            list_page_limit: parsedLimit
                        };
                        if (passwordInput.text.length > 0) draft.webdav_password = passwordInput.text;
                        var request = new XMLHttpRequest();
                        request.open("PUT", "file:///home/root/xovi-zotero-bridge/.zotbridge-settings-draft.json");
                        request.onreadystatechange = function() {
                            if (request.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
                            if (request.status !== 0 && (request.status < 200 || request.status >= 300)) {
                                bridgeSettings.status = "Could not save settings draft";
                                return;
                            }
                            bridgeSettings.run(["settings-apply"]);
                        };
                        request.send(JSON.stringify(draft));
                    }

                    Component.onCompleted: {
                        run(["settings", "--json"]);
                    }

                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                    }

                    Flickable {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        contentWidth: width
                        contentHeight: form.height + 80
                        clip: true
                        Column {
                            id: form
                            width: parent.width - 80
                            x: 40
                            y: 40
                            spacing: 18

                            Text { text: "Zotero Bridge"; font.pixelSize: 40; font.bold: true }
                            Text { text: bridgeSettings.status; font.pixelSize: 22; wrapMode: Text.WordWrap; width: parent.width }
                            Text { text: "WebDAV storage"; font.pixelSize: 30; font.bold: true }
                            Text { text: "Server URL (HTTPS)"; font.pixelSize: 22 }
                            TextInput { id: urlInput; width: parent.width; font.pixelSize: 24; selectByMouse: true
                                Keys.onReturnPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                                Keys.onEnterPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                            }
                            Rectangle { width: parent.width; height: 2; color: "black" }
                            Text { text: "Username"; font.pixelSize: 22 }
                            TextInput { id: usernameInput; width: parent.width; font.pixelSize: 24; selectByMouse: true
                                Keys.onReturnPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                                Keys.onEnterPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                            }
                            Rectangle { width: parent.width; height: 2; color: "black" }
                            Text { text: "Password"; font.pixelSize: 22 }
                            TextInput { id: passwordInput; width: parent.width; font.pixelSize: 24; echoMode: TextInput.Password; selectByMouse: true
                                Keys.onReturnPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                                Keys.onEnterPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                            }
                            Text { id: passwordHint; font.pixelSize: 18 }
                            Text { text: "reMarkable folder path"; font.pixelSize: 22 }
                            TextInput { id: folderInput; width: parent.width; font.pixelSize: 24; selectByMouse: true
                                Keys.onReturnPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                                Keys.onEnterPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                            }
                            Rectangle { width: parent.width; height: 2; color: "black" }
                            Text { text: "List page size (1-100)"; font.pixelSize: 22 }
                            TextInput {
                                id: listPageLimitInput
                                width: parent.width; font.pixelSize: 24; selectByMouse: true
                                text: "8"
                                maximumLength: 3
                                onTextChanged: {
                                    var digitsOnly = text.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
                                    if (digitsOnly !== text) text = digitsOnly;
                                }
                                Keys.onReturnPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                                Keys.onEnterPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                            }
                            Rectangle { width: parent.width; height: 2; color: "black" }
                            Text { text: "Queue tag"; font.pixelSize: 22 }
                            Rectangle {
                                width: parent.width; height: 64; border.width: 2; border.color: "black"; color: "white"
                                TextInput {
                                    id: queueInput
                                    anchors.fill: parent; anchors.leftMargin: 12; anchors.rightMargin: 12
                                    font.pixelSize: 24; selectByMouse: true
                                    text: bridgeSettings.queueTag
                                    onActiveFocusChanged: {
                                        if (activeFocus && bridgeSettings.tags.length > 0)
                                            bridgeSettings.openTagPicker = "queue";
                                    }
                                    onTextChanged: {
                                        bridgeSettings.queueTag = text;
                                        if (activeFocus && bridgeSettings.tags.length > 0)
                                            bridgeSettings.openTagPicker = "queue";
                                    }
                                    Keys.onReturnPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                                    Keys.onEnterPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                                }
                            }
                            Text { text: "Completion tag"; font.pixelSize: 22 }
                            Rectangle {
                                width: parent.width; height: 64; border.width: 2; border.color: "black"; color: "white"
                                TextInput {
                                    id: syncedInput
                                    anchors.fill: parent; anchors.leftMargin: 12; anchors.rightMargin: 12
                                    font.pixelSize: 24; selectByMouse: true
                                    text: bridgeSettings.syncedTag
                                    onActiveFocusChanged: {
                                        if (activeFocus && bridgeSettings.tags.length > 0)
                                            bridgeSettings.openTagPicker = "synced";
                                    }
                                    onTextChanged: {

                                            bridgeSettings.openTagPicker = "synced";
                                    }
                                    Keys.onReturnPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                                    Keys.onEnterPressed: bridgeSettings.dismissKeyboard()
                                }
                            }
                            Flickable {

                                contentWidth: width; contentHeight: tagChoices.height

                                        delegate: Rectangle {

                                            Text { anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter; x: 12; text: modelData; font.pixelSize: 22 }
                                            MouseArea {
                                                anchors.fill: parent
                                                onClicked: {
                                                    if (bridgeSettings.openTagPicker === "queue")
                                                        bridgeSettings.queueTag = modelData;
                                                    else
                                                        bridgeSettings.syncedTag = modelData;
                                                    queueInput.focus = false;
                                                    syncedInput.focus = false;
                                                    bridgeSettings.openTagPicker = "";
                                                    Qt.inputMethod.hide();
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            Rectangle { width: parent.width; height: 2; color: "black" }
                            Row {
                                spacing: 16

                                            delegate: Rectangle {

                                }
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                width: parent.width; height: 300
                                color: "white"; border.width: 2; border.color: "black"
                                Flickable {
                                    anchors.fill: parent; anchors.margins: 10
                                    clip: true
                                    contentWidth: width
                                    contentHeight: eventText.height
                                    interactive: contentHeight > height
                                    Text {
                                        id: eventText
                                        text: bridgeSettings.events.map(function(event) {
                                            return event.timestamp + "  " + event.action + "  " +
                                              event.event + (event.tag ? " [" + event.tag + "]" : "") +
                                              (event.count !== undefined ? " " + event.count : "") +
                                              (event.item_key ? " Zotero=" + event.item_key : "") +
                                              (event.filename ? " file=\"" + event.filename + "\"" : "") +
                                              (event.rm_uuid ? " [" + event.rm_uuid + "]" : "") +
                                              (event.stage ? " stage=" + event.stage : "") +
                                              (event.error ? " (" + event.error + ")" : "") +
                                              (event.retained_in_source ? " retained in source" : "");
                                        }).join("\n")
                                        width: parent.width; font.pixelSize: 18; wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
